title: Reducing Hallucinated Transcripts in Whisper via Hallucination Space Projection
abstract: arXiv:2609.04561v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Whisper is a widely used foundation model for automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its generative decoder can produce fluent hallucinated transcripts for inputs containing little or no speech. We propose a training-free, inference-time method to reduce these hallucinations using low-rank projection of decoder activations. A compact hallucination-associated subspace is estimated from non-speech calibration data, and decoder hidden states are projected away from this subspace during inference.   We evaluate two variants: always-on, which applies projection to all inputs, and gated, which applies it only when Whisper predicts that an input is likely non-speech. Across non-speech benchmarks, always-on projection reduces average hallucination rate (HR) from 31.31% to 2.44%, a 92.21% relative reduction, while gated projection reduces HR to 3.74%, an 88.05% relative reduction, with lower false rejection of genuine speech. translated_title: 通过幻觉空间投影减少Whisper中的幻觉转录文本
translated_abstract: Whisper是一种广泛使用的自动语音识别（ASR）基础模型，但其生成式解码器可能会为包含少量语音或完全没有语音的输入生成流畅的幻觉转录文本。我们提出了一种无需训练的推理时方法，通过解码器激活的低秩投影来减少这些幻觉。该方法从非语音校准数据中估计出一个紧凑的与幻觉相关的子空间，并在推理过程中将解码器隐藏状态投影远离该子空间。我们评估了两种变体：always-on（始终开启）模式，对所有输入都应用投影；以及gated（门控）模式，仅在Whisper预测输入可能为非语音时应用投影。在非语音基准测试中，始终开启的投影将平均幻觉率（HR）从31.31%降低到2.44%，相对减少了92.21%；门控投影将幻觉率降低到3.74%，相对减少了88.05%，同时对真实语音的误拒率更低。在LibriSpeech上，门控（模式...）
tldr: 提出一种无需训练的推理时方法，通过将Whisper解码器激活投影远离从非语音校准数据估计出的幻觉相关子空间，使非语音输入上的幻觉率从31.31%大幅降低至2.44%。
en_tdlr: A training-free inference-time method that projects Whisper's decoder activations away from a hallucination-associated subspace estimated from non-speech calibration data, reducing hallucination rate on non-speech inputs from 31.31% to 2.44%.
